user.title: Standby power measurement
user.description: Choose the power sensor that measures your whole home (for example a P1 / smart meter power sensor) or a smart plug.

data_description.power_sensor: Sensor that reports the current power in W or kW. Its difference before and after switching a device off is the standby power.
data_description.energy_price: Used to calculate the yearly cost of standby power, in your Home Assistant currency.
data_description.baseline_seconds: How long to measure while the device is still in standby.
data_description.off_seconds: How long to measure after the device has been unplugged or switched off.
data_description.settle_seconds: Waiting time after you confirm the device is off, before measuring again.
